title: Prospective Chain-Realizability-Constrained Activation Validation, Outcome-Blind World Acquisition under Routed-Chain Support Quotas, Activation-Field External Replication, Support-Selection Bias Firewall, Cross-Ecology Regime Calibration & Q0 Authority Re-entry Experiment

two_track.track_A_terminal_question: Why this near-equal legal move rather than that one, beyond obvious tactical dominance?
two_track.track_A_novelty: Executable causal support is treated as a first-class prospective transport condition: fresh worlds are admitted using outcome-blind ROUTED-chain realizability and quota rules before activation outcomes.
two_track.track_B_implementation: GitHub must expose the same support state machine to explanation routing so unsupported PGN positions abstain before mechanism language is generated.
two_track.firewall: Track-B coverage or UX gains cannot promote Track-A authority; Track-A PASS only authorizes evidence labels consumed by Track B.

scientific_object.activation: A_f(e,x)=1 iff FULL_CLASS_f support differs from BASE support under the frozen TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM protocol.
scientific_object.support: R(e,x)=1 iff frozen pair qualification is active and the frozen router grammar deterministically yields a legal three-arm ROUTED chain for engine e on world x before any FULL_CLASS outcome.
scientific_object.estimand: Prospective prediction of A_f(e,x) conditional on R(e,x)=1, with acquisition quotas defined entirely from outcome-blind world/pair/chain information.
scientific_object.transport_target: The frozen P22 R1_BOUNDARY_PLUS_LOAD field; no refit before primary held-out adjudication.

live_rivals.claim: P22 failed only because support was underpowered; once R=1 quotas are guaranteed, the frozen R1 field transports without recalibration.
Adequate R=1 support is necessary but not sufficient; source/ecology shift changes activation calibration even after support is guaranteed.
Adequate support exists but the frozen R1 field fails the preregistered prospective thresholds.

acquisition.stop_rule: Scan frozen sources in predeclared order and stop at the first prefix satisfying all support quotas. Never continue to improve predicted activation balance.

selection_bias_firewall.principle: Condition on executability, not on treatment response.
audit: No activation/FULL_CLASS/Q0 outcome read before acquisition seal.
Routed-chain eligibility is computed identically for ACTIVE- and INACTIVE-predicted cells.
Prediction distribution is inspected only after the acquisition prefix is sealed.
No source replacement, quota relaxation, or world extension after prediction distribution is seen.
diagnostic_only: Compare acquired geometry/context distribution with the full source candidate pool.
Report P22 R1 predicted ACTIVE fraction after seal.

30.5 < base_max_gap_cp <= 74.5 AND family_event_count_target > 1926.5 => ACTIVE else INACTIVE

primary_adjudication.source_robustness: Primary PASS additionally requires balanced accuracy >=0.60 in at least two distinct held-out source ecologies with both classes present; single-class sources are reported but do not count toward this condition.

verdicts.PASS: All primary pooled thresholds pass and source-robustness condition passes.
verdicts.PARTIAL_PASS: Pooled thresholds pass but source robustness fails, or only a predeclared family-specific subset passes with adequate support.
verdicts.FAIL: Adequate support and positive outcomes exist but pooled thresholds fail.
verdicts.HOLD: Support quotas fail or no positive activation occurs.

secondary_calibration.purpose: Diagnose H_SUPPORT_PLUS_SHIFT after frozen-field adjudication; may estimate source calibration offsets but cannot rescue the primary verdict.

q0_reentry.condition: Only cells prospectively predicted ACTIVE by a primary-PASS activation field may enter downstream Q0 fiber testing.

paper_program.central_claim_candidate: Executable intervention support can be prospectively separated from mediator activation and used as an outcome-blind sampling constitution for external causal-mechanism validation.
paper_program.negative_result_value: If R1 fails after support is guaranteed, P23 cleanly distinguishes model nontransport from support failure.
paper_program.implementation_claim: The same machine-readable support state can govern explanation abstention in the PGN product without upgrading heuristic commentary to causal authority.

claim_ceiling: Routed-chain conditioning is an experimental support condition, not proof of population representativeness.
R1 thresholds are frozen empirical rules, not universal chess constants.
Do not condition source/world acquisition on predicted or observed activation.
Do not claim human cognition or objective chess truth.
Do not use Track-B usefulness as evidence for Track-A causal validity.
